newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks drop at noon as investors stay out.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks drop at noon as investors stay out.

text.p: Pakistan stocks dropped at noon in lacklustre trading as investors remained on the sidelines before the 1997/98 (July-June) budget due in June, dealers said. "Foreign funds and investors are in a wait-and-see mood before the budget," dealer Zaina Nowsherwan said. "Trading volume has dropped sharply and only speculators are generating some activity."
The index fell 6.01 points, or 0.39 percent, to 1,528.50 at noon. Losers led gainers 168 to 43. Engro Chemicals fell 2.0 rupees to 150. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
